svg.title: Sorting robot wiring schematic
svg.desc: Connection overview: 12V supply and two bucks feed the brain ESP32, three A4988 drivers with NEMA17 motors, three endstops, an SG90 servo, and the ESP32-CAM over UART.
svg.text: GND = ONE common net: PSU−, both bucks, both ESP32s,
all A4988 GND, endstop COM, servo, every cap. (critical)
INPUT_PULLUP, no resistors · any open/broken = HIGH
Flash via HW-381 · not GPIO12 for TX
